title: From the top 10 migration statuses with the highest variance in instance me
question: From the top 10 migration statuses with the highest variance in instance memory (MEMORY_MB) among instances that have a non-deleted instance info cache record, display each migration status along with its memory variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP), and also show (for each status) every instance VM state’s memory variance and standard deviation (using STDDEV only and never STDDEV_POP) computed only from instances that have system metadata with KEY = 'image_image_type'. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    m.status AS migration_status,
    i.vm_state,
    i.memory_mb,
    i.uuid
  FROM migrations m
  JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid
  JOIN instance_info_caches c ON c.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND c.deleted = 0
),
top10 AS (
  SELECT
    migration_status,
    VARIANCE(memory_mb) AS mem_var,
    STDDEV(memory_mb) AS mem_std
  FROM base
  GROUP BY migration_status
  ORDER BY mem_var DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
meta AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT instance_uuid
  FROM instance_system_metadata
  WHERE `key` = 'image_image_type'
),
vm AS (
  SELECT
    b.migration_status,
    b.vm_state,
    VARIANCE(b.memory_mb) AS vm_var,
    STDDEV(b.memory_mb) AS vm_std
  FROM base b
  JOIN meta mm ON mm.instance_uuid = b.uuid
  GROUP BY b.migration_status, b.vm_state
)
SELECT
  t.migration_status,
  t.mem_var,
  t.mem_std,
  v.vm_state,
  v.vm_var,
  v.vm_std
FROM top10 t
LEFT JOIN vm v ON v.migration_status = t.migration_status
ORDER BY t.mem_var DESC, v.vm_state

WITH base AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    m.status AS migration_status,
    i.vm_state,
    i.memory_mb,
    i.uuid
  FROM migrations m
  JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid

),
top10 AS (
  SELECT
    migration_status,
    VARIANCE(memory_mb) AS mem_var,
    STDDEV(memory_mb) AS mem_std
  FROM base
  GROUP BY migration_status
  ORDER BY mem_var DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
meta AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT instance_uuid
  FROM instance_system_metadata
  WHERE `key` = 'image_image_type'
),
vm AS (
  SELECT
    b.migration_status,
    b.vm_state,
    VARIANCE(b.memory_mb) AS vm_var,
    STDDEV(b.memory_mb) AS vm_std
  FROM base b
  JOIN meta mm ON mm.instance_uuid = b.uuid
  GROUP BY b.migration_status, b.vm_state
)
SELECT
  t.migration_status,
  t.mem_var,
  t.mem_std,
  v.vm_state,
  v.vm_var,
  v.vm_std
FROM top10 t
LEFT JOIN vm v ON v.migration_status = t.migration_status
ORDER BY t.mem_var DESC, v.vm_state

WITH base AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    m.status AS migration_status,
    i.vm_state,
    i.memory_mb,
    i.uuid
  FROM migrations m
  JOIN instances i ON i.uuid = m.instance_uuid
  JOIN instance_info_caches c ON c.instance_uuid = i.uuid AND c.deleted = 0
),
top10 AS (
  SELECT
    migration_status,
    VARIANCE(memory_mb) AS mem_var,
    STDDEV(memory_mb) AS mem_std
  FROM base
  GROUP BY migration_status
  ORDER BY mem_var DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
meta AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT instance_uuid
  FROM instance_system_metadata
  WHERE `key` = 'image_image_type'
),
vm AS (
  SELECT
    b.migration_status,
    b.vm_state,
    VARIANCE(b.memory_mb) AS vm_var,
    STDDEV(b.memory_mb) AS vm_std
  FROM base b
  JOIN meta mm ON mm.instance_uuid = b.uuid
  GROUP BY b.migration_status, b.vm_state
)
SELECT
  t.migration_status,
  t.mem_var,
  t.mem_std,
  v.vm_state,
  v.vm_var,
  v.vm_std
FROM top10 t
LEFT JOIN vm v ON v.migration_status = t.migration_status
ORDER BY t.mem_var DESC, v.vm_state

WITH top_statuses AS (
  SELECT 
    m.status,
    VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS memory_variance,
    STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS memory_stddev
  FROM migrations m
  JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  JOIN instance_info_caches iic ON i.uuid = iic.instance_uuid
  WHERE iic.deleted = 0
  GROUP BY m.status
  ORDER BY memory_variance DESC
  LIMIT 10
),
vm_state_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    m.status,
    i.vm_state,
    VARIANCE(i.memory_mb) AS vm_memory_variance,
    STDDEV(i.memory_mb) AS vm_memory_stddev
  FROM migrations m
  JOIN instances i ON m.instance_uuid = i.uuid
  JOIN instance_system_metadata ism ON i.uuid = ism.instance_uuid
  WHERE ism.`key` = 'image_image_type'
  GROUP BY m.status, i.vm_state
)
SELECT 
  ts.status,
  ts.memory_variance,
  ts.memory_stddev,
  vss.vm_state,
  vss.vm_memory_variance,
  vss.vm_memory_stddev
FROM top_statuses ts
JOIN vm_state_stats vss ON ts.status = vss.status
ORDER BY ts.memory_variance DESC, vss.vm_state
